newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S.Star says on target for prospectus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S.Star says on target for prospectus.

text.p: Film and television production company Southern Star Group Ltd said on Monday that it was on target to achieve its prospectus forecast for a A$9.4 million net profit in the year to March 31, 1996.

Earlier, Southern Star announced a 28 percent rise in operating profit to A$6.0 million in the first half of the year. But its net profit for the period fell 11.2 percent to A$4.07 million, because of an abnormal gain in the previous period.

"The result was underpinned by consistent growth in all business segments and the directors are confident that the company will achieve the full year's prospectus forecast," Southern Star said. Southern Star is forecasting a A$14.5 million operating profit for the full year.
The company said that traditionally the majority of its profits were earned in the second half of the year.
Southern Star listed on the Australian Stock Exchange on September 26. About 45 percent of Southern Star's shares were sold in an initial public offering.
Its shares were unchanged at A$1.70 at 12.05 p.m. (0105 GMT), having listed at A$1.75 on September 26 at a 25 percent premium to its A$1.40 issue price.
